title: An Evaluation of Cultural Value Alignment in LLM

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to adopt the persona of an average person from 20 different countries to answer the 24-item Values Survey Module (Hofstede's 6 cultural dimensions), and comparing the numerical responses against human ground truth scores using a proposed Deviation Ratio metric.
Comparing the cultural value alignment of the model outputs when prompted in English, Chinese, or the specific aligned language of the target country to observe language-induced value shifts.
